title: Greenroom serving sync — playback & preflight
content:
Greenroom note (pre-meeting scratchpad) — quick mic check before weekly serving sync

Meeting: Serving runtime weekly (greenroom preflight)
Owner / facilitator: Aker Nwosu
Date: 2026-03-12 (meeting is 2026-03-13 10:00 - 11:00 PT)
Duration: 60m (aim for 45m + 15m overflow)
Attendees expected: core runtime, infra-console on-call, release-engineering rep, Maya (console), Jonah (infra)

Primary goals for this week
- Rapidly validate the new KV-cache patch (INF-3124) on canary; collect perf numbers and any regression signals.
- Decide next-step roll strategy if canary holds: widen to dedicated pool or rollback path.
- Triage 99th-p95 tail latency anomaly (observability traces + Stackdriver traces).
- Quick sync on console rollout: streaming tokens UI change and cost dashboard hooks.

Agenda (playback format)
1) Mic check + 1-line health (5m) — quick round: green/yellow/red, one-sentence rationale.
2) KV-cache canary playback (15m) — Maya presents perf summary, Jonah covers infra capacity and GPU mem pressure.
   - Goal: agree whether to widen canary or hold.
   - Data to bring: INF-3124 perf dashboard (95/99 latency, tokens/sec), sample traces for warm/cold cache.
3) Tail-latency signal deep-dive (15m) — I will show top 3 traces and correlation with batching config.
   - Hypothesis: recent autoscaler bump increased batching window -> bigger variance on tails.
   - Quick check items: autoscaler logs, batching histograms, request sequence length distribution.
4) Console streaming tokens rollout (10m) — Maya: e2e smoke, feature flag gating, telemetry changes.
   - Ask: finalize rollback criteria and who flips flag.
5) Action review + ownership (5m) — capture committers and due dates.
6) Overflow & parking lot (10m) — any blockers that need follow-up meetings.

Preflight checklist (things I need to confirm before meeting)
- [ ] Perf dashboards for INF-3124 updated and pinned (owner: Maya) — link in linked_artifacts.
- [ ] Canary pool up and tagged (canary-aker-03) and metrics streaming working (owner: Jonah).
- [ ] Traces for three representative requests extracted and annotated (owner: Aker).
- [ ] Console feature flag smoke run completed in staging (owner: Maya).
- [ ] Slack thread created for live notes and immediate decisions (channel: #serving-greenroom).

Notes to self (scratchpad)
- Keep KV-cache rollout decision binary: widen to 20% dedicated if 99p latency <= baseline+10% and no mem growth. If not, revert to previous binary and file follow-up.
- Watch for GC spikes in logs around 03:40–04:10 window (from last run). Might correlate with small batch flush.
- If we see >3% error rate after widen, automatic fallback should trigger to model-variant alpha-quant. Confirm fallback test coverage.

Action items (to capture in meeting and assign)
- A1: Maya — finalize INF-3124 perf snapshot and post to Confluence by 2026-03-12 EOD. (linked: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-3124)
- A2: Jonah — validate canary node labels and ensure autoscaler threshold documented; report status in meeting. Due 2026-03-13 before noon.
- A3: Aker — collect and annotate 3 problematic traces, add comments to INF-3124 ticket. Due 2026-03-12 night.
- A4: Sofia — run console feature-flag rollback rehearsals in staging and record steps. Due 2026-03-14.
- A5: Release-eng rep (TBD) — if widen approved, schedule dedicated pool expand and update capacity plan (INF-CAP-2026Q1).

Parking lot / follow-ups (post-meeting)
- Deep dive on batching algorithm alternative (experiment: reduce max batch wait from 30ms -> 18ms). Owner: Jonah + Aker.
- Longer-term: KV-cache eviction policy tweak (LRU vs segmented) — schedule a design session next sprint. Owner: eng-serving-runtime.
- Cost impact analysis if we widen canary (expected +7% GPU minutes) — finance ping.

Conversation prompts / phrase bank (for meeting)
- "Mic check: is the canary environment representative of production steady-state?"
- "If we accept a slight 95p uptick, what's the hard 99p threshold we won't cross?"
- "If rollback happens, do we need a hotfix to revert config or is flag flip enough?"

Rough decision tree (quick reference during meeting)
- Canary metrics: if 99p <= baseline*1.10 AND mem delta < 5% -> widen to 20% for 24h.
- If 99p > baseline*1.10 OR mem delta >= 5% -> rollback and open postmortem ticket.

Quick links to paste (for meeting chat)
- INF ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-3124
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/456
- Rollout runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/serving-runbook

Final micro-notes:
- Keep status verbs in meeting short: lgtm / hold / rollback. Avoid long debates — capture and slot follow-up.
- If we can't decide in 15m on the canary, tentatively default to hold and schedule an immediate 30m deep-dive with infra.

End greenroom scratchpad.
